NOTE
**Still not ready: the border color and radius concern is unanswered, and the dark-theme screenshots aren't precise**

New: The author squashed the work into one commit, and the diff is now additions only, so the earlier accidental deletions look restored. Missing: no sign the border color and radius were matched to the left sidebar link as Yogesh asked (the description only says outline and offset). The dark-theme before/after screenshots are different sizes (370x60 vs 367x62), so they aren't precise.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have the author answer Yogesh's open points, with no reviewer assigned yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commit, @Ayush-0217. Before review, please make the focus ring's color and border radius match the left sidebar link, as Yogesh described, and replace the dark-theme screenshots with [precise before/after ones](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots) of the same region.
```
